page_title: EMP 0-0 GEN | Empoli v Genoa 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
90+2' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and Koni De Winter (Genoa) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90' The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
89' A snap shot by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile produces a good save to thwart him.
88' Aaron Martin (Genoa) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
88' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
88' A cross from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
85' The substitution has been made. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) has replaced Nicolo Cambiaghi.

80' Mattia Destro (Empoli) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
78' Djed Spence (Genoa) plants a goal-bound header towards the top of the net after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
77' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Stefano Sabelli and he is replaced by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
77' Substitution. Vitinha (Genoa) in, Mateo Retegui out.

76' What an opportunity! Koni De Winter (Genoa) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
75' The yellow card is received by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli).

74' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went well wide of the left post.
73' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
72' Mattia Destro (Empoli) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ermano Feliciani saw the whole situation.
71' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mattia Destro (Empoli) replacing Szymon Zurkowski.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) coming on for Alberto Grassi.
70' 11:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
69' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is caught offside!
67' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
66' Koni De Winter (Genoa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
64' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Josep Martinez makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
62' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post.
62' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
58' Dangerous play by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli). Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
54' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replaces Alberto Cerri.
54' Here's the change. Bartosz Bereszynski leaves the pitch and Liberato Cacace (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
53' What was Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
53' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.

50' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Josep Martinez, who pulls off a comfortable save!
46' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) is flagged for offside.
46' Alberto Gilardino has made a change at the break. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has come on in place of Ruslan Malinovsky.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Empoli win a corner.
43' Flag goes up against Mateo Retegui (Genoa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
35' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) commits a foul and Ermano Feliciani immediately signals a free kick.
35' There's an opportunity for Youssef Maleh (Empoli) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
33' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
33' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
30' Some neat passing and movement from Genoa as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
26' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
26' Corner kick. Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) brought his opponent down.
24' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:1.
21' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
21' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) sends the corner into the box, but Josep Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.
16' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle after Koni De Winter (Genoa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
15' The opposition can't get near Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
14' The game is interrupted as Alberto Cerri (Empoli) is flagged offside.
12' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
12' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
12' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes the corner.
11' Koni De Winter (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Genoa hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
7' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
7' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
7' The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
4' Djed Spence (Genoa) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
4' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Ermano Feliciani stops the game and makes a call.
3' Empoli players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has started.
Empoli will kick the game off.
Ermano Feliciani will supervise the game today.
